snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978860/Shoe_it_All/

A release date trailer for Shoe It All! Swing and fling your shoes to cause chaos in this physics-based mayhem. Discover secrets, unlock bonus levels and fill your journal with shiny stickers. Master the perfect throw to SHOE IT ALL!
